tok 1.0 "LAN Party"

pool org "Organiser"
  lane me "Organiser (you)"
    start planning "LAN party planning started"
    task invite "Send the invitations to the 10 friends"
    task find-games "Find out which games the friends want to play"
    and split
    task appoint-date "Appoint a date for the LAN party"
    xor agree ["8 or more people agree on the date?"]
    task other-date "Appoint another date"
    task check-games "Check whether you have all the games"
    xor missing ["Games missing?"]
    task download "Download the missing games"
    xor games-merge
    and joined
    task find-beer "Find out how much beer the friends will require"
    xor enough ["Enough beer?"]
    task buy-beer "Buy the missing beer"
    xor beer-merge
    task enjoy "Enjoy the LAN party"
    end done "LAN party enjoyed"

flow planning -> invite -> find-games -> split
flow split -> appoint-date -> agree
flow agree -> joined "yes"
flow agree -> other-date "no"
flow other-date -> appoint-date
flow split -> check-games -> missing
flow missing -> download "yes"
flow missing -> games-merge "no" default
flow download -> games-merge -> joined
flow joined -> find-beer -> enough
flow enough -> beer-merge "yes"
flow enough -> buy-beer "no" default
flow buy-beer -> beer-merge -> enjoy -> done
